rows.corpus_definition: Material that is used to make clothes or furniture covers.
rows.example_en: This fabric feels very soft to the touch.

rows.corpus_definition: A fact or situation that influences a result.
rows.example_en: Price is a key factor in our choice.

rows.corpus_definition: to slowly lose colour, brightness, or strength
rows.example_en: The old photograph had faded to almost nothing.

rows.corpus_definition: To lose consciousness for a short time.
rows.example_en: She felt faint because of the extreme heat.

rows.corpus_definition: something or someone that you know well.
rows.example_en: That man looks familiar to me.

rows.corpus_definition: to know something or someone quite well.
rows.example_en: Are you familiar with this computer program?

rows.corpus_definition: To close or join two parts together tightly.
rows.example_en: Please fasten your seatbelt before the flight takes off.

rows.corpus_definition: To want to have or do something at this moment.
rows.example_en: I feel like eating pizza for dinner today.

rows.corpus_definition: A large boat that carries people or cars across a river or sea.
rows.example_en: We took the ferry across the river this morning.

rows.corpus_definition: A boat that carries people or cars across water.
rows.example_en: The ferry arrives at the port at noon.

rows.corpus_definition: a thin thread-like part of a plant, fabric, or material
rows.example_en: Whole grains contain more fiber than white bread.
